svg.title: 工具调用总览：模型提出调用，应用选择执行路径，处理结果后回填上下文。

tspan.tspan: 工具批次：逐个准备，按所选方式安排执行

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
runLoop：调用模型
streamAssistantResponse

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 得到 assistant 消息

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
stopReason 是
error / aborted？

div.style: color: rgb(96, 54, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
发送 turn_end、agent_end
结束 runLoop

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: content 中有 toolCall？

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 发送 turn_end

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: stopReason 是 length？

div.style: color: rgb(96, 54, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
failToolCallsFromTruncatedMessage
为截断调用生成失败结果

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
executeToolCalls
选择整批工具的执行方式

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
顺序路径
executeToolCallsSequential

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
并行路径
executeToolCallsParallel

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
每个调用：prepareToolCall
查工具 → 准备与校验参数
前置钩子、取消检查

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: preparation.kind

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
直接采用准备阶段的结果
跳过 execute 和 finalize

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
executePreparedToolCall
调用 tool.execute，处理进度和结果

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
finalizeExecutedToolCall
afterToolCall 调整结果

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
按所选路径发送完成事件
构造并发送工具结果消息

div.style: color: rgb(24, 60, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
汇总批次
返回 messages、terminate

div.style: color: rgb(24, 60, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
runLoop 接收批次结果
hasMoreToolCalls = !terminate
结果追加到 currentContext.messages 和 newMessages

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
后续决策
prepareNextTurn → shouldStopAfterTurn
再处理 steering 与必要时的 follow-up

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
进入下一轮
如有待处理消息，先注入上下文

div.style: color: rgb(96, 54, 16) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
发送 agent_end
结束 runLoop
